In this returning season of FINDING, six heartfelt reunions honour people who left a lasting mark. Nearly 40 years after Basic Military Training, Minister Ong Ye Kung searches for his BMT buddy Eric, while actor-host Noah Yap reunites with Ma’am Haiyan, the mentor who believed in him and supported his family through difficult times. Actor Elvin Ng and his mother travel to Indonesia to surprise Jumi, the domestic helper who became their pillar of strength, while 23-year-old Leticia journeys to Central Java to thank Auntie Mas, who helped raise her for 12 years. Dino Isaac reconnects with the Primary 3 teacher whose kindness gave him hope after a traumatic childhood, while radio DJ Gerald Koh and conservation educator John Chua surprise the teachers who inspired and guided them. Together, these emotional journeys celebrate friendship, gratitude and the lasting impact of those who quietly shape lives.

Best Telenovela - National Winner Asian Academy Creative Awards (2020) | Kin is a drama about the complexities of life, love and family relationships. Years have passed since Yoke and Ella had their lives turned upside-down when they returned to be with their rightful families after having been swapped at birth. Years later, Yoke has seemingly embraced her role as a status-conscious, high society Shelley, assuming a leadership role in the family business. Ella has accepted her fate as a member of the salt of the earth, working-class Loh family but struggles to make something of her life. Has the nature vs nurture battle run its course or are relationships between the families still as fraught and complicated as ever? The Lohs, Shelleys, Hassans, and Balas have overcome personal loss, incarceration, as well as estrangement of their loved ones; yet lingering tensions remain. Mysteries continue to unfold as characters pursue their individual agendas, while emotional drama abounds as surprising twists are revealed that threaten the stability to which they have become accustomed..

Brand new series where the UK's most passionate cooks get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to launch their own food brand to the British public. Cooking Up a Fortune sees amateur foodies, who dream of escaping the rat race and cooking for a living, create and sell their dishes to hundreds of real diners in a purpose-built food arena. Each week the winning kitchen gets to launch their idea for a food business to paying customers in one of Europe's busiest food markets.

Three generations of the Jin family live under one roof. Mrs. Jin-Ke mei-man has two sons, You-Tsai and You-De. You-Tsai abandoned the family many years ago, leaving his wife Siou-Ying to shoulder the huge responsibility of the Jin family business selling fish products at market. Although Siou-Ying was betrayed by You-Tsai, she has still been a dutiful daughter to her mother-in-law, and has single-mindedly raised four children. 三代同堂的金家，奶奶金柯美满，膝下有两子-有财跟有德。有财早年抛弃家庭离开，妻子秀英一肩扛下金家重责大任，在市场从事贩卖鱼货的工作。虽然有财对不起秀英在先，但秀英仍然孝顺婆婆，也拉拔彦钧等四个孩子长大。透过金家的故事，除了体会婚姻的酸与甜，还得面对婆媳、姑嫂、妯娌间的「那些小事」…，也透视到家庭与爱情真正爱的真谛！

In the ashes of war, three strangers - a woman forced to sell her body, a starving orphan, and a broken soldier - find fragile solace together. Shadow Of Fire is a raw, haunting tale of loss, survival, and the fleeting warmth of human connection.

Gravedigger Max Broll and retired soccer star Baroni team up to find Max’s stepmother Tilda, the local police commissioner, who has been abducted and buried alive in the woods. The clock is ticking – Tilda won`t survive more than 48 hours underground.

After surviving a car crash when running away from home, Tia finds herself having nowhere to go. Seeking out the family of the crash victim, she moves in with them and threatens to upend the family’s delicate balance.

p.t: The Reports on Sarah and Saleem
p.d: The illicit affair of a married Palestinian man and a married Israeli woman in Jerusalem takes a dangerous political dimension when they are spotted in the wrong place at the wrong time leaving them to deal with more than their broken marriages.

Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

Pearl Harbor: Minute by Minute reconstructs the December 7, 1941 attack in real time, capturing the shock, chaos and heroism as it unfolded. Through archival footage and eyewitness accounts, it reveals the moment that changed history and led the US into war.
Non-stop breaking stories, expert analysis and extensive news coverage every hour.

Twenty-five years after 9/11, this gripping documentary tells the untold story of the 170 people trapped inside Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant on the top floors of the World Trade Center’s North Tower. Through never-before-seen family archives, emergency calls and emotional interviews with survivors, the film follows the final hour of those stranded above the impact zone with no means of escape.At the heart of the story is Jupiter Yambem, an Indian immigrant and banquet manager at the restaurant. Just a week earlier, he had switched to the morning shift so he could spend more time with his young son, a decision that placed him at work on that fateful day. From the streets of Manhattan to the Loktak Lake of Manipur, India, the film traces the unknown devastation of 9/11 across continents, forever changing families, communities and lives thousands of miles away.
